thought.text: Selesai. Sekarang saya verifikasi key pemenangnya benar-benar berisi $1 dan bisa chat.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && tail -3 nm2_api.txt; echo "=== verifikasi ==="; K=$(tail -1 nm2_api.txt | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}'); echo "key: $K"; curl -s --max-time 30 https://nomask.ai/api/v1/me -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" | head -c 250; echo; echo "=== chat test ==="; curl -s --max-time 90 https://nomask.ai/api/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"balas satu kata: ok"}],"max_tokens":10}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | head -c 400

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && tail -3 nm2_api.txt; echo \"=== verifikasi ===\"; K=$(tail -1 nm2_api.txt | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,\"\",$2);print $2}'); echo \"key: $K\"; curl -s --max-time 30 https://nomask.ai/api/v1/me -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" | head -c 250; echo; echo \"=== chat test ===\"; curl -s --max-time 90 https://nomask.ai/api/v1/chat/completions -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"balas satu kata: ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":10}' -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" | head -c 400", "summary": "Verify the winning nomask key", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 150}
